description: Characterization fixture (T001, spec 018-corpus-config-seam): byte-identical snapshot of every src/archive/location.ts function whose output depends on the static SOURCE_LAYOUTS map, for the 9 legacy Port Breton source ids. Captured BEFORE SOURCE_LAYOUTS was touched by T013. Protects SC-001/INV-4: the 9 legacy archive paths must stay byte-identical after the retirement of the static registry in favor of generic derivation + validated overrides.
